title: ר' תנחום בר' ירמיה

paragraphs: R' Tanhum son of R' Yirmeyah: Jerusalem Berakhot, end of chapter 4; Midrash Hazit, at “Set me as a seal”; Midrash Eikhah, at “He made my strength fail.” He was in Hefer and gave rulings. They said, “But R' Mana, your teacher, is in Tzipporin, within twelve mil!” He said that he did not know: Jerusalem Gittin 1:2. Yelammedenu, Aharei Mot: R' Nahum bar Yirmeyah and R' Mani in Tzipporin. It is one person.
